scripts.check: turbo run typecheck test && biome check
scripts.release:frontend: node scripts/release-config.mjs --check && turbo run typecheck build --filter=@wiseroutine/desktop...
scripts.test:capture-browser: pnpm --filter @wiseroutine/desktop exec playwright test quick-capture.spec.ts session-integrity.spec.ts
scripts.addon:verify: pnpm --filter @wiseroutine/addons build && pnpm --filter @wiseroutine/addon-tools test && node --test scripts/addon-launch.test.mjs && node scripts/check-addon-catalog.mjs
scripts.test:addon-browser: pnpm --filter @wiseroutine/addon-sdk build && pnpm --filter @wiseroutine/addons build && pnpm --filter @wiseroutine/desktop exec playwright test --config playwright.addons.config.ts
